title: The component of rationalPullbackStageComparison on a pair object equals commonStagePullbackComparison at that pair and the same enlargement.
statement: The component of rationalPullbackStageComparison on a pair object equals commonStagePullbackComparison at that pair and the same enlargement.

source.place: Common-stage subargument, steps 3–5; proved component calculation.

proof.text:
Expand both comparisons into the recorded transition isomorphism, the rational
pullback scalar comparison and the inverse source transition. Their component formulas
are identical; equality of the hom components gives equality of the isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Fully proved helper extracted to keep each module within the compile-time bound.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStagePullback_endpoint
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω]
    [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (P : Pair l Ω X) (L : Index l Ω) (h : P.stage ≤ L) :
    (rationalPullbackStageComparison l Ω f h).app P.obj =
      commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f P L h
